captions.detailed: A light-grey, retro-futuristic blimp designed for advertising, featuring a large, elongated envelope with a conical nose tip and a flat rectangular display sign mounted on its side. Below the hull is a small dark gondola, flanked by two side-mounted engine pylons with tiltable engine pods and rotating two-blade propellers. The tail features a cruciform stabilizer configuration equipped with pivoting rudders and elevator control surfaces for flight maneuvering.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of an advertising blimp. It must include an elongated envelope with a side-mounted display sign, a small ventral gondola, rotatable engine pylons on each side with spinning propeller blades, and a rear cruciform tail with functional, pivoting elevator and rudder surfaces.
captions.factory: The code constructs the main hull envelope using a loft or revolved profile with a conical nose. It then creates the side billboard as a thin box with a contrasting frame and face. Underneath, a cylindrical gondola is attached. The side engine nacelles are built using cylinders for the pylons, connected to rotatable engine pods with two-blade propeller assemblies. The tail assembly is created using intersecting planes for the fins, with separate movable flaps modeled for the rudders and elevators, all linked via revolute and continuous articulations.
